Screen Ruler

📌

Hey Product Hunt 👋, A few weeks ago I was in a work call, I couldn't remember the term "semantic search", for some reason I went blank it was honestly a bit awkward. I probably could have Googled it mid-call but that would just be awkward. I built Hintly so it never happens again. Hintly sits in your Google Meet toolbar and offers in-call hints like: - Defining terms names and acronyms - Fills in the blanks when you blank! - Fact checks claims live - Remembers and surfaces details about people mentioned in the call - Logs tasks intended for you ... all in real time. No bot joins your call, Hintly reads Meet's own live captions. It's off until you turn it on. First 60 minutes are free so feel free to try it out and let me know what you think! [...] Going blank on a term mid-call and not wanting to Google it while everyone is watching is such a relatable moment! I like that Hintly reads Meet's own captions instead of sending a bot into the call. When it surfaces details about a person who was mentioned, does that only come from the current call, or can it remember them from earlier meetings too?
